correctness.rationale: Minimum ordinary zero forcing sets of the 20-vertex GP(10,3) are exactly the 13,520 eight-vertex masks (none of 77,520 seven-vertex subsets forces). The exact closure algorithm exhausts all C(20,8)=125,970 masks. Exchanging one chosen and one unchosen site builds a simple graph with 178,560 undirected edges. All-source BFS across 13,520 vertices exhaustively visits 91,388,440 unordered pairs, comparing exact d with j=8−|A∩B|: 47,380 have excess1 and none have excess>=2; by j counts 2:16080,3:25080,4:5730,5:360,6:130; radius7 diameter8, eccentricities 7:980 and 8:12540. I inspected the original C++ checker including loop bounds and forcing closure, then independently wrote and executed a separate C++ all-source BFS / mask enumeration reproducing all numbers; finite exhaustive proof, not inference from samples. Strictness witness masks 255 and 999 have j2 but graph distance3.
residual_risks: Independent executable exhaustive integer verification is a computer-assisted finite proof, not an independent human formal verification.
